sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 6 September 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000029-P1 was put before Summit Wellness Center 029 on behalf of Supplier.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a group service charge of 1.25 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Influenza minimum take of 1,220 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer signed off on the terms.
